title: Onboarding Documentation

onboardingAudiences.responsibility: Operate roadmap closure, evidence updates and governance commits.
Implement product changes only when the roadmap-selected task names a product repository.
Confirm validation evidence, JSON contract parsing and non-goal preservation.
Use Engram project ai-native as auxiliary memory and keep git/governance primary.

onboardingSteps.action: Read session context and roadmap before selecting or executing a task.
Inspect the latest execution archive for continuity evidence.
Verify root and product repository git status independently.
Use Engram project ai-native only as auxiliary continuity memory.
Run existing validators relevant to the impacted repository.
Record product commit, governance commit, validation and push status in governance evidence.

learningPath.title: Governance model
learningPath.objective: Understand that roadmap, session context and archive evidence control task closure.

learningPath.title: Repository boundaries
learningPath.objective: Understand root governance and the three independent product Git repositories.

learningPath.title: Setup flow
learningPath.objective: Understand local status checks, validation readiness and one-attempt push recording.

learningPath.title: Product evidence
learningPath.objective: Understand where product artifacts and validators live when a task impacts product code.

learningPath.title: Closure discipline
learningPath.objective: Understand product commit rules, governance commit rules and future-task guardrails.

governanceOperator: Verify git status before editing files.
Confirm exact roadmap task name and deliverables.
Avoid opening or closing future tasks.
Update current and archive evidence after validation.
productContributor: Work only in the product repository named by the roadmap.
Run existing validators relevant to that repository.
Avoid changing VERSION files without explicit authorization.
validationReviewer: Record blockers as STOP HUMAN REQUIRED only when local state cannot be safely reconciled.
continuityMaintainer: Treat Engram as auxiliary and git/governance as primary.
Record blocked Engram or push operations as CONTEXTUAL_NON_BLOCKING when caused by external policy or unverified remote destination.

onboardingGuardrails: Onboarding documentation preserves independent Git boundaries between root governance and product repositories.
Roadmap must be read directly before task execution.
Documentation-only onboarding does not automate onboarding or change identity/access systems.
Documentation-only onboarding does not modify product runtime, workflows, pipelines or VERSION files.
Engram is auxiliary continuity memory and is not a primary source of truth.
Future roadmap tasks remain unopened until explicitly selected.
Onboarding gaps are recorded without closing runbook or final audit tasks.
